```{r, message=FALSE}
library(lblvm)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
# Helper function for data generation
P_2PL <- function(theta, a, b) 1 / (1 + exp(-(as.vector(theta %*% a) + b)))

P_DRM <- function(theta, a, b, nu, cut_score){
  p <- P_2PL(theta = theta, a = a, b = b)

  ncats <- length(cut_score)+1

  probs <- matrix(nrow = nrow(theta), ncol = ncats-1)

  for(i in 1:length(cut_score)){
    probs[,i] <- stats::pbeta(q = cut_score[i],
                              shape1 = p*nu,
                              shape2 = (1-p)*nu)
  }
  return(cbind(probs,1)-cbind(0,probs))
}

# Helper to generate test dataset
make_test_data_cont <- function() {
  set.seed(1)
  dimension <- 1

  N <- 200
  nitem <- 5

  item <- rep(1, nitem)
  item <- cbind(item, 0, log(7))

  theta <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(
    N,
    mean = rep(0, dimension),
    sigma = diag(dimension)
  )

  data <- matrix(ncol = nitem, nrow = N)
  for (i in 1:nitem) {
    mu <- P_2PL(theta, item[i, 1:dimension], item[i, dimension + 1])
    data[, i] <- stats::rbeta(N, shape1 = mu * exp(item[i, dimension + 2]), shape2 = (1 - mu) * exp(item[i, dimension + 2]))
  }

  colnames(data) <- paste0("v", 1:nitem)
  return(data)
}

make_test_data_cat <- function() {
  set.seed(1)
  dimension <- 1

  N <- 500
  nitem <- 6

  item <- rep(0.7, nitem)
  item <- cbind(item, 0, log(7))

  theta <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(
    N,
    mean = rep(0, dimension),
    sigma = diag(dimension)
  )

  data <- matrix(ncol = nitem, nrow = N)
  for(i in 1:nitem){
    if(i %in% 1:3) threshold <- c(.2,.4,.6,.8)
    if(i %in% 4:6) threshold <- c(0.19, 0.44, 0.56, 0.81)
    p_mat <- P_DRM(theta, 
                   item[i,1:dimension], 
                   item[i,dimension+1], 
                   exp(item[i,dimension+2]), 
                   threshold)
    for(p in 1:N){
      data[p,i] <- sample(x = 1:5, size = 1, prob = p_mat[p,])
    }
  }

  colnames(data) <- paste0("v", 1:nitem)
  return(data)
}

# generate data
continuous_data <- make_test_data_cont()
categorical_data <- make_test_data_cat()

rm("P_DRM")
rm("P_2PL")
```


## Bounded-continuous Response Model

```{r}
head(continuous_data)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit_continuous <- efa_cont(data = continuous_data, dimension = 1)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
formula_string <- "
f1 ~ v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 # factor structure

v1.nu == v2.nu # equal values

v1.f1 <- 1 # fix parameter
"

fit_continuous <- cfa_cont(formula = formula_string, data = continuous_data)
```



#### Estimated Parameters

```{r}
fit_continuous$par_est
```



## Discretized Response Model


```{r}
head(categorical_data)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
t_sd <- t_prior_sd(200,5)

fit_categorical <- efa_drm(data = categorical_data, dimension = 1, t_prior = t_sd)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
formula_string <- "
f1 ~ v1 + v2 + v3 + v4 + v5 + v6 # factor structure

v1.nu == v2.nu # equal values

v1.f1 <- 0.7 # fix parameter
"

fit_categorical <- cfa_drm(formula = formula_string, data = categorical_data)
```



#### Estimated Parameters

```{r}
fit_categorical$par_est
```

#### Estimated Category Thresholds

Items 4--6 have been designed to have narrow middle categories.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=2.5, out.width="70%", fig.align='left'}
plot(fit_categorical)
```
